For the two wave vectors the Lagrange identity reads
\begin{equation}
(\mathbf{k}\times\mathbf{q})\cdot(\mathbf{k}\times\mathbf{q}) = (\mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{k})(\mathbf{q}\cdot\mathbf{q}) - (\mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{q})^2 .
\label{eq:lag}
\end{equation}
